create_ImplicitronModelFactory: create an ImplicitronModelFactory instance to initialize an implicit rendering model with configurable resume settings
call_ImplicitronModelFactory: call the ImplicitronModelFactory with an experiment directory and optional accelerator to get a model instance
resume_model_from_checkpoint: resume a model from a specific epoch checkpoint using the resume_epoch parameter on ImplicitronModelFactory
force_resume_model: force resume a model from checkpoint and raise FileNotFoundError if no checkpoint exists in the experiment directory
load_model_state_dict: load a model's state dict from a checkpoint file with strict or non-strict mode fallback
